# Blu Baby Show

> Blu Baby Show is a 3D animated short-form series for toddlers and their parents.
> It follows Blu, a 2-year-old boy, through small everyday moments and the big
> feelings that come with them. The show's idea: teach feelings before facts.

Episodes are short (about 15 to 30 seconds) and are published on Instagram and
YouTube. The website, blubabyshow.com, links to the episodes, runs a free email
newsletter and sells a small number of printable PDFs.

## Characters
- Blu: a curious 2-year-old boy, the main character.
- Mum: Blu's mother.
- Dad: Blu's father.
- Sister: Blu's baby sister.
- Puppy: the family's Dalmatian puppy.

## Audience
- Parents and caregivers of babies and toddlers (about 0 to 4 years).
- Young children who watch with a parent.
- Viewers are worldwide; the largest share is in India.

## Numbers (Instagram @theblubabyshow, November 2026)
- 92M+ lifetime views
- 1.9M+ likes
- 64.2K followers

## Content
- Short animated episodes about everyday feelings: frustration, sharing, a new baby sibling, bedtime, being brave.
- Slapstick shorts ("Blu vs the World") and family slice-of-life shorts.
- "Learn with Blu" picture carousels: numbers, animals, colours, emotions.

## Shop (digital PDF downloads only; nothing is shipped)
- What to Say When Your Toddler Melts Down: a 17-page PDF of 20 calm, sourced scripts for everyday toddler meltdowns (ages 1 to 4), with a fridge card. ₹49 / US$3. https://www.blubabyshow.com/shop/meltdown-scripts/
- Blu's Big Feelings Colouring Book: 20 colouring pages of Blu and his family, each naming a feeling, for ages 2 to 6. ₹149 (about US$7). https://www.blubabyshow.com/shop/coloring-book/
- Payment: UPI, RuPay and cards in India; major cards elsewhere. Download link is shown on screen and sent by email after payment.
- Refunds: within 7 days of purchase, by email.
